name: Remote Grok Build
tagline: Drives the build setup on your own computer from the Grok app
description: Reaches the builder installed on your home machine from the app, so work started on a phone picks up on the computer holding the code. Projects can be split across separate workers, with a side channel for running several turns alongside one another, and none of it needs a tunnel or a public address.
author: FrankYin17
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
